# Codex Telegram Bridge v0.3.10

This release brings the Rust bridge runtime to full production parity with the
Python bridge and lands a broad performance pass.

- Adds the complete Rust runtime: Telegram adapter contracts, modular core,
  app-server backend boundary, offline CLI parity surface, Codex workflow
  parity, and the 91 control bot aligned with 9527.
- Completes Telegram business parity, including discussion topology probes,
  pending session authentication recovery, and activation prompt intent
  reconciliation.
- Hydrates and renders legacy sessions with Python parity; remaps legacy luna
  profiles onto stored session spaces.
- Runs `/ask` prompts on ephemeral fork threads whose events are swallowed
  before projection, mirroring the Python bridge's kill-switch.
- Performance: keyed update dispatcher, cached sessions panel backed by SQLite
  projections with event-driven invalidation, per-request Telegram timeouts,
  projection truncation and stale-thread eviction, deletion retry backoff, and
  faster upgrade snapshots.
- Reliability: idempotent schema repair for prestamped `user_version`, shared
  request deadlines with reconnect retry, and comm/exe-based Codex process
  matching with replay peak RSS reporting.
- Adds a Rust CI workflow and path-filtered Python CI.
